name: Erik Spoelstra
bio: Erik Spoelstra is one of the longest-tenured and most respected head coaches in the NBA. Promoted from video coordinator to head coach in 2008, he has led the Heat to multiple Finals appearances and back-to-back championships in 2012 and 2013.

name: Chris Quinn
bio: Former Notre Dame guard and longtime Heat staff member, currently serving as the lead assistant under Spoelstra.

name: Caron Butler
bio: Two-time NBA All-Star and 2011 champion, now guiding the Heat from the bench.

name: Octavio De La Grana
bio: Player development specialist focused on shooting and skill work.
